environment.description: Kubernetes 1.24 cluster running the WebSocket service as a privileged container with hostPath volume mount at /var/log/ws-events. Pod runs as root (UID 0). No PodSecurityPolicy or Pod Security Standards enforced. The relay service on port 9090 accepts raw TCP frames and processes injected headers, allowing an attacker to escalate CRLF injection into arbitrary relay commands. The hostPath mount allows log poisoning that can be read by other node-level services.
